metaDescription: Order custom polyester highlighters for your next event or promotion. Eco-friendly and durable. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Polyester highlighters, like those made from rPET, offer a durable and eco-friendly alternative to standard plastic options. The fabric construction provides a unique texture that resists cracking and absorbs ink evenly, making them ideal for trade shows or corporate gifts. Custom imprinting on polyester creates a soft, vibrant logo that stands out. Perfect for marketing directors seeking sustainable promotional products that align with green initiatives.
heroAltText: Custom polyester highlighters in assorted neon colors with company logo imprint, eco-friendly rPET material
